// Supabase Edge Function: signup
//
// Creates the account and provisions the workspace in one call, per
// supabase/SIGNUP_FLOW.md. Runs as the service role, which never reaches a
// browser. verify_jwt is off because the caller has no account yet.
//
// Kept as .ts.txt on purpose: the design-system compiler sweeps every .ts file
// in this project into _ds_bundle.js and Deno code breaks it (SETUP.md). To
// redeploy with the CLI, copy it to supabase/functions/signup/index.ts first.

import { createClient } from 'jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2';

const CORS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS'
};

const json = (body: unknown, status = 200) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { ...CORS, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: CORS });
  if (req.method !== 'POST') return json({ error: 'method_not_allowed' }, 405);

  let body: Record<string, string>;
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ error: 'bad_request' }, 400);
  }

  const email = String(body.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = String(body.password ?? '');
  const admin_name = String(body.admin_name ?? '').trim();
  const company_name = String(body.company_name ?? '').trim();
  const employee_band = body.employee_band ? String(body.employee_band) : null;
  const sector = body.sector ? String(body.sector) : null;

  const fields: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(email)) fields.email = 'Enter a valid email address.';
  // Long over complex: length is what actually resists guessing.
  if (password.length < 10) fields.password = 'Use at least 10 characters.';
  if (!admin_name) fields.admin_name = 'Enter your name.';
  if (!company_name) fields.company_name = 'Enter your business name.';
  if (Object.keys(fields).length) return json({ error: 'validation_failed', fields }, 422);

  const admin = createClient(
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
    Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!
  );

  const { data: created, error: authError } = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({
    email,
    password,
    email_confirm: true,
    user_metadata: { name: admin_name }
  });

  if (authError || !created?.user) {
    // Never confirm whether an address is registered: that is an account
    // enumeration oracle on a public form.
    const already = String(authError?.message ?? '').toLowerCase().includes('already');
    return json({
      error: 'signup_failed',
      message: already
        ? 'We could not create that account. If you already have one, try signing in or resetting your password.'
        : 'We could not create that account. Please try again.'
    }, already ? 409 : 500);
  }

  const { data: provisioned, error: provisionError } = await admin.rpc('provision_tenant', {
    p_user_id: created.user.id,
    p_email: email,
    p_admin_name: admin_name,
    p_company_name: company_name,
    p_nation: 'england_wales',
    p_employee_band: employee_band,
    p_sector: sector,
    p_trial_days: 14
  });

  if (provisionError) {
    // Without this the address is burned and they cannot try again.
    await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(created.user.id);
    console.error('provision failed', provisionError);
    return json({ error: 'signup_failed', message: 'We could not finish setting up your workspace. Please try again.' }, 500);
  }

  return json({ ok: true, ...provisioned });
});
